paragraphs: The 540i xDrive is part of the current G60-generation 5 Series, introduced in 2023. It uses BMW's B58 engine — a 3.0-litre inline-six petrol unit that's widely regarded as one of BMW's most reliable modern engines. The B58 has been in production since 2015 and has proven itself across multiple BMW models, including the 3 Series, 4 Series, 5 Series, 6 Series, 7 Series, 8 Series, X3, X4, X5, X6 and X7. For the G60 540i xDrive, the B58 is paired with xDrive all-wheel drive as standard, making it the most powerful mainstream 5 Series petrol variant before the range-topping M5.
about.boldParagraph: The 540i xDrive is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
